text:
mina: Quick note from onboarding breezy-lite: we observed punctuation inversion in RTL-mixed strings after q8 quant bring-up. Specifically, Arabic text with embedded latin parentheses shows closing parenthesis on the left side post-detok. Small but causes visual confusion in downstream apps.

sung: Can you paste sample?

mina: sample: 
`input: "الترجمة (مثال) and some English (e.g., test)"`
fp32 detok: "الترجمة (مثال) and some English (e.g., test)"
q8 detok:  "الترجمة )مثال( and some English (e.g., test)"

olga: That looks like bidi reordering applied incorrectly during detok. Are we applying Unicode Bidi algorithm after concatenation? We used to preserve original visual order for mixed fragments.

ci-bot: ci:tokenizer-tests failed (test-name=rtl-paren-preserve). See logs: https://ci.redwood/tokenizer/rtl-paren-preserve/1012

mina: Token ids were identical, so it's a detok-stage bidi handling change. Probably a normalizer/regionalization change.

sung: Revert plan: pin tokenizer normalizer to v1.12 for canary and open PR to add RTL-paren test. Also add a small integration test in web-preview that renders mixed bidi sequences to catch visual skew.

olga: I'll take the PR. Also add a lightweight JS-based bidi-checker (we already have one in web-ui) into our eval harness so we can assert visual parity between float and quant runs.

mina: Filed ML-933 with examples and CI links.

ci-bot: deploy:breezy-lite canary started (cny-20260610-3).

mina: thx. reopening if anything else crops up.
